sql: SELECT * FROM studenti
note: inline: all rows, all columns of studenti

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, (bursa + 100) / 2 AS "Jumatate" FROM studenti
note: inline: half of (bursa + 100) -- precedence needs the parentheses

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, an, data_nastere FROM studenti
note: name, first name, year, birth date

sql: SELECT DISTINCT bursa FROM studenti
note: distinct scholarship values (NULL appears once)

sql: SELECT nume AS "Nume", prenume AS "Prenume", an AS "An", data_nastere AS "Data nasterii" FROM studenti
note: aliases on every column of 1

sql: SELECT nume || ' ' || prenume || ', ' || an AS "Studenți pe ani de studiu" FROM studenti ORDER BY an
note: name + first name + comma + year, sorted by year, one column with quoted alias (space between nume and prenume = assumption)

sql:
SELECT nume, prenume, data_nastere FROM studenti
WHERE data_nastere BETWEEN TO_DATE('01/01/1995','dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE('10/06/1997','dd/mm/yyyy')
ORDER BY an DESC
note: born 1995-01-01 .. 1997-06-10, order by year DESC (ties unspecified)

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, an FROM studenti WHERE TO_CHAR(data_nastere,'YYYY') = '1995'
note: born in 1995 via TO_CHAR (text compared with text)

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, an FROM studenti WHERE TO_CHAR(data_nastere,'YYYY') = 1995
note: same, but number literal: Oracle converts implicitly; PG would error without the compat operator

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NULL
note: no scholarship

sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL AND an IN (2,3) ORDER BY nume ASC, prenume DESC
note: scholarship, years 2 and 3, nume ASC, prenume DESC

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, bursa, bursa * 1.15 AS "Bursa marita" FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL
note: scholarship raised by 15%

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE nume LIKE 'P%' AND an = 1
note: name starts with P, year 1

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%a%'
note: two a's in first name (at least two)

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%a%' MINUS SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%a%a%'
note: exactly two a's

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume IN ('Alexandru', 'Ioana', 'Marius')
note: first name in list

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL AND grupa LIKE 'A%'
note: scholarship holders in half-year A

sql: SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%' MINUS SELECT * FROM studenti WHERE prenume LIKE '%a%a%'
note: exactly one lowercase a in first name: contains a MINUS contains two

sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM profesori WHERE TRIM(prenume) LIKE '%n'
note: trap: profesori.prenume is CHAR(10) -> TRIM before LIKE

sql: SELECT nume, prenume FROM profesori WHERE prenume LIKE '%n'
note: the trap itself, without TRIM: must return 0 rows in Oracle

sql: SELECT SYSDATE AS "Astazi" FROM DUAL
note: today

sql: SELECT nume, data_nastere, MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere) AS "Luni" FROM studenti
note: months between today and birth date

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'Day') AS "Ziua" FROM studenti
note: weekday of birth (TO_CHAR 'Day' is blank-padded to 9 chars)

sql: SELECT CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT('Elevul ', prenume), ' este in grupa '), grupa) AS "Text" FROM studenti
note: with CONCAT (2 args only -> nested)

sql: SELECT 'Elevul ' || prenume || ' este in grupa ' || grupa AS "Text" FROM studenti
note: with ||

sql: SELECT nume, LPAD(bursa, 10, '$') AS "Bursa" FROM studenti
note: scholarship on 10 chars padded with $ (NULL stays NULL)

sql:
SELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(TRIM(nume),1,1)) || UPPER(SUBSTR(TRIM(nume),2)) AS "Nume", LENGTH(TRIM(nume)) AS "Lungime"
FROM profesori WHERE nume LIKE 'B%'
note: professors whose name starts with B: first letter lower, rest upper, length

sql:
SELECT nume, data_nastere,
       ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere) / 12) + 1)) AS "Urmatoarea zi",
       NEXT_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere) / 12) + 1)), 'SUNDAY') AS "Duminica"
FROM studenti
note: birth date, next birthday (strictly after today), first Sunday after it

sql: SELECT nume, prenume, TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'MM') AS "Luna" FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NULL ORDER BY TO_CHAR(data_nastere, 'MM')
note: students without scholarship ordered by birth month (number)

sql: SELECT nume, bursa, DECODE(bursa, 450, 'premiul 1', 350, 'premiul 2', 250, 'premiul 3', 'mentiune') AS "Premiu" FROM studenti
note: DECODE, NULL falls into the default

sql: SELECT TRANSLATE(nume, 'ia', 'ai') AS "Nume" FROM studenti
note: swap i<->a in names

sql:
SELECT nume,
       TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere) / 12) || ' ani ' ||
       MOD(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere)), 12) || ' luni și ' ||
       TRUNC(SYSDATE - ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere)))) || ' zile' AS "Varsta",
       TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(data_nastere, 12 * (TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, data_nastere) / 12) + 1)) - SYSDATE) AS "Zile pana la ziua"
FROM studenti
note: age as 'x ani y luni și z zile' + days to next birthday

sql:
SELECT nume, TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1), 'MONTH') AS "Prima zi",
       DECODE(bursa, 450, bursa * 1.10, 350, bursa * 1.15, 250, bursa * 1.20, 0) AS "Bursa noua"
FROM studenti
note: next month scholarship, first day of next month, 0 for no scholarship

sql: SELECT nume, LPAD(RPAD('*', bursa / 50, '*'), 9, ' ') AS "Stelute" FROM studenti WHERE bursa IS NOT NULL
note: stars (1 star = 50 RON) right aligned (width 9 = 450/50)

sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, n.valoare, p.nume AS profesor, p.prenume AS prenume_prof
FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol
                JOIN didactic d ON d.id_curs = n.id_curs
                JOIN profesori p ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof
note: students, grades, professors who gave them (via didactic)

sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs
WHERE n.valoare = 10 AND c.titlu_curs = 'BD'
note: students with a 10 at BD (only 10 and 'BD' hard-coded)

sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = d.id_curs
note: professors with their courses

sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p LEFT JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof LEFT JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = d.id_curs
note: + professors without a course

sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM cursuri c LEFT JOIN didactic d ON c.id_curs = d.id_curs LEFT JOIN profesori p ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof
note: + courses without a professor

sql: SELECT p.nume, p.prenume, c.titlu_curs FROM profesori p LEFT JOIN didactic d ON p.id_prof = d.id_prof FULL JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = d.id_curs
note: both: professors without course and courses without professor

sql:
SELECT s1.nume, s2.nume, TRIM(TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'Day')) AS "Ziua"
FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'D') = TO_CHAR(s2.data_nastere, 'D')
 AND (s1.nume < s2.nume OR (s1.nume = s2.nume AND s1.nr_matricol < s2.nr_matricol))
ORDER BY TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'D'), s1.nume
note: pairs born on the same weekday, alphabetical pair (same-surname pairs kept via nr_matricol tie-break)

sql:
SELECT s1.nume, s2.nume, TRIM(TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'Day')) AS "Ziua"
FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON TRIM(TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'Day')) = TRIM(TO_CHAR(s2.data_nastere, 'Day')) AND s1.nume < s2.nume
ORDER BY TO_CHAR(s1.data_nastere, 'D'), s1.nume
note: classmates' variant: strict s1.nume < s2.nume (drops same-surname pairs)

sql:
SELECT s2.nume || ' ' || s2.prenume || ' a luat nota mai mare ca ' || s1.nume || ' ' || s1.prenume || ' la materia ' || c.titlu_curs || '.' AS "Comparatie"
FROM studenti s1 JOIN note n1 ON s1.nr_matricol = n1.nr_matricol
                 JOIN note n2 ON n2.id_curs = n1.id_curs AND n2.valoare > n1.valoare
                 JOIN studenti s2 ON s2.nr_matricol = n2.nr_matricol
                 JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n1.id_curs
note: sentences: who got a higher grade than whom at the same course (hint on the page: 118 rows)

sql:
SELECT s1.nume, s1.prenume, s2.nume AS nume2, s2.prenume AS prenume2, ABS(s1.data_nastere - s2.data_nastere) AS "Diferenta (zile)"
FROM studenti s1 JOIN studenti s2 ON s1.nr_matricol < s2.nr_matricol
ORDER BY 5
note: pairs with age difference (days), ascending

sql: SELECT s.nume AS student, p.nume AS profesor FROM studenti s JOIN profesori p ON LENGTH(TRIM(s.nume)) = LENGTH(TRIM(p.nume))
note: student-professor friendships: surnames with the same number of letters (CHAR(10) trap -> TRIM)

sql: SELECT s.nume AS student, p.nume AS profesor FROM studenti s JOIN profesori p ON LENGTH(s.nume) = LENGTH(p.nume)
note: the trap itself: without TRIM, LENGTH(p.nume) is always 10

sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.titlu_curs FROM cursuri c JOIN note n ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs WHERE n.valoare <= 8
note: courses with a grade <= 8

sql:
SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti NATURAL JOIN note WHERE valoare >= 7
MINUS
SELECT nume, prenume FROM studenti NATURAL JOIN note WHERE valoare < 7
note: students with ALL grades >= 7 (MINUS, as taught)

sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume FROM studenti s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM note n WHERE n.nr_matricol = s.nr_matricol AND n.valoare < 7)
note: same via NOT EXISTS by nr_matricol (equal on this data?)

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.nume, s.prenume FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs
WHERE c.titlu_curs = 'OOP' AND n.valoare IN (7, 10) AND TRIM(TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'Day')) = 'Tuesday'
note: 7 or 10 at OOP on a Tuesday

sql:
SELECT s.nume, s.prenume, c.titlu_curs, n.valoare,
       TRIM(TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'MONTH')) || ', ' || TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'YYYY') AS "Sesiunea",
       CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(n.data_notare), 'DD')) < 30 THEN '+' END AS "Grea"
FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol JOIN cursuri c ON c.id_curs = n.id_curs
WHERE n.valoare >= 5
note: passed (>=5) any course: name, first name, course, grade, session 'MONTH, YYYY', '+' if month has < 30 days

sql:
SELECT s.nume, TRIM(TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'MONTH')) || ', ' || TO_CHAR(n.data_notare, 'YYYY') AS "Sesiunea",
       DECODE(SIGN(30 - TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(n.data_notare), 'DD')), 1, '+', NULL) AS "Grea"
FROM studenti s JOIN note n ON s.nr_matricol = n.nr_matricol WHERE n.valoare >= 5
note: same with the implicit text->number comparison (Oracle allows it)
